children: Millrose priced a $1.0 billion private senior notes offering split into $500M 6.50% notes due 2029 and $500M 6.75% notes due 2031.
Offering priced at 100.000% for both tranches; interest accrues from October 6, 2026; expected close on October 6, 2026.
Notes sold to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A and to certain non-U.S. persons under Regulation S.
Net proceeds, plus $500M drawn under a delayed draw term loan, intended for general corporate purposes including potential homesite acquisition related to Dream Finders Transaction.
If Dream Finders Transaction isn't completed by May 13, 2027, Millrose will use proceeds/cash/borrowings to mandatorily redeem all outstanding 2031 notes.
